video_title: Luka Doncic IS BETTER THAN Anthony Edwards

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the comparison between Anthony Edwards and Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: There's two guys that played last night, Anthony Edwards and Luka Doncic.
quotes.quote: There's two guys that played last night, Anthony Edwards and Luka Doncic. While we're talking about Anthony Edwards, Ray, do you still feel that Anthony Edwards is better than Luka Doncic?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on why he prefers Anthony Edwards over Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: I don't think he's better because one, they both are amazing offensively.
quotes.quote: I don't think he's better because one, they both are amazing offensively. Luka Doncic is probably more talented offensively if far as with his passing and the way he could score, but Anthony Edwards is just as is just as good offensively. On the other side, it's a landslide. Anthony Edwards is a dog, he guarding, he's he's a dog. So I'm I'm rolling with Anthony Edwards. That's that's my that's my reasoning right there.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson

quotes.quote: We didn't have another All-Star on our team when we went to Western Conference Finals. We played with Luka Doncic. You have Jalen Brunson. No, no, but it's not the same Jalen Brunson. quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on his personal preference for Anthony Edwards
quotes.excerpt: I like Anthony Edwards better. I like Luka Doncic too though.
quotes.quote: I like Anthony Edwards better. I like Luka Doncic too though. I think Luka Doncic is one of the most talented players in this league and he looks good. I like who I like. Ain't me hating on Luka Doncic, ain't me hating on LeBron James like they love to say. I like Kobe Bryant, I like Michael Jordan. That's that's my personal opinion. I like who I like. Not going to change that.
